LESSON: READING 3.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Reading 3.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 3.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can one improve the way they read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 3.2.1 Intensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving as learners uses the skill of interpretation and inference to get the meaning of words

used in the passage and predicts events in the text.

● Communication and collaboration as learners collaborates with others in pairs or groups to accomplish given tasks. During

role-play good communication skills are seen as they are acting in the play.

Values:
● Patriotism is fostered as the learner reads on pollution and how to improve the environment.

● Responsibility is developed as learners read passages on pollution which will enable the learner to take care of the

environment.

30

Reading passages on pollution is linked to soil pollution in Agriculture and Nutrition and Integrated Science
